# machine: 10.7.20.228 (mac1-dns)   date: 2026-11-23 12:03:15 IST

$ networksetup -getdnsservers 'Wi-Fi'
10.7.20.228
10.7.18.17

$ scutil --dns | awk '/^resolver #1/{f=1} f&&/nameserver\[/{print} /^resolver #2/{exit}'

  nameserver[1] : 10.7.18.17

$ dig @10.7.20.228 app.paradise.test +noall +answer +stats | grep -E 'app.paradise.test|SERVER'

;; SERVER: 10.7.20.228#53(10.7.20.228)
